The escape flag is a second required edit: parseArgs camel-cases --allow-single-lineage and assertKnownFlags(args, FANOUT_FLAGS, inputError) at fanout-run.cjs:121 fails closed on an unregistered flag, so 'allowSingleLineage' must be added to FANOUT_FLAGS at 30-35.

delegation-and-orchestration.md never states the numeric fan-out trigger (only a dispatch trigger at :40 and a write-freeze obligation at :76-78), so AGENTS.md and the repo-rules file drop out of the change set; the trigger is stated once per mode in the command doc and presentation asset.

The consolidated change set is five edits across four files with zero new artifacts: FANOUT_FLAGS entry, the 6-line refusal after fanout-run.cjs:3396 worded from the shipped cli-deepseek-harness sentence, the flag added to the capped unit case at :2477 plus one negative and one positive case, the flag added to the three stress fixtures at fanout.vitest.ts:165,756,794, and the four doc clauses.

Iteration 4's 'the unit suites do not exercise fanout-config-json at all' was inferred from a search pattern that does not match how the unit suite builds configs; the suite spawns the CLI with JSON matrices at unit/fanout-run.vitest.ts:2459 and :2489.
